# Functions

A function maps every element of a set to exactly one element of
another set.

Let

$$
f:A\to B.
$$

We say that $f$ is **injective** if

$$
f(a_1)=f(a_2)
\implies
a_1=a_2.
$$

## Example

Consider

$$
f:\R\to\R
$$

defined by

$$
f(x)=2x+1.
$$

Suppose

$$
f(a)=f(b).
$$

Then

$$
2a+1=2b+1,
$$

so

$$
a=b.
$$

Therefore $f$ is injective.

$$
\begin{align*}
1+1&=2 \\
\implies 2+2&=4 \\
\R
\end{align*}
$$
